test_tensors_allclose: assert two PyTorch tensors are close within a given relative and absolute tolerance
run_python_script_in_process: run a Python script in the current process with custom sys.argv for coverage tracking
test_dict_contains_subset: assert a dictionary contains all key-value pairs from an expected subset dictionary
test_object_attrs_equal: assert an object's attributes match expected values from a dictionary of attribute names and values
test_module_params_all_zeros: assert all weight and bias parameters of a PyTorch module are initialized to zero
